messages:
sylvie: FYI hitting flaky duplicate POSTs in the Kotlin onboarding sample. On emulator cold-start, sometimes two identical requests go out -> double user creation in test db. Anyone seen similar?

kevin: Haven't seen dupes but we've had retry/auth races. Can you paste okhttp/retrofit config and the sample app flow?

sylvie: Repro steps: 1) Fresh emulator, 2) open sample app, 3) tap Sign up fast once. Logs show POST /api/users then another identical POST ~120ms later. Attached small log.

sylvie: ```
2026-03-23T11:03:12.345Z INFO okhttp3.OkHttp: --> POST http://10.0.2.2:8080/api/users
2026-03-23T11:03:12.467Z INFO okhttp3.OkHttp: <-- 500 http://10.0.2.2:8080/api/users (122ms)
2026-03-23T11:03:12.468Z INFO okhttp3.OkHttp: --> POST http://10.0.2.2:8080/api/users
```

kevin: Looks like your Authenticator is doing async refresh (enqueue) which can race with the original call. If the original execution isn't suspended/cancelled, the upstream retry layer might re-run the request. Also check interceptor order — auth should be before retry so credentials are present for retries.

oliver: Also worth checking the Call creation semantics. If our retry wrapper creates a fresh Call and also doesn't cancel the in-flight one during token refresh, duplicates are expected. In old SDK we saw this with coroutine adapters + naive retry.

anya: Workarounds I suggest: make token refresh blocking in the Authenticator (synchronous call), add jittered backoff on retry, and debounce the sample app button so UI can't trigger multiple submits during spinner. For emulator cold-start you might also temporarily raise OkHttp dispatcher maxRequests so requests aren't queued oddly.

sylvie: I pushed a tiny PR: make token refresh blocking in Authenticator.reauthenticate(), added a small jittered exponential backoff, and debounce on the signup button in sample app. Link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-samples/pull/42>

dev-bot: deploybot: staging build 2056789012-branch queued for test on android-emulator-31

kevin: Nice. Can you paste the backoff snippet you used?

sylvie: ```kotlin
fun jitteredBackoff(base: Long, attempt: Int, jitter: Double = 0.2): Long {
  val raw = base * (1 shl attempt)
  val factor = 1.0 + Random.nextDouble(0.0, jitter)
  return (raw * factor).toLong().coerceAtMost(10_000L)
}
```

oliver: Let's add an integration test that simulates delayed token endpoint (200-500ms) and rapid UI taps to catch regressions. If tests pass we can cherry-pick to release.

sylvie: Will add the test and update onboarding doc to call out the debounce + recommended Authenticator pattern. Also added a note about dispatcher tuning for emulators.

anya: Thanks for the quick fix. If QA green, we should roll into next patch and update the migration note for teams using coroutine adapters.

sylvie: OK will follow up with PR for tests/docs. Marking this thread as resolved for onboarding DX once QA approves. :tada:
